raw_segments.text: So she wouldn't kiss her hand, so she didn't kiss it, so she ran away.
He kept exclaiming with hysterical delight, insolent delight it might have been called
if it had not been so spontaneous.
So the other one called her Tigress, and a Tigress she is, so she ought to be flogged
That's just what I think, she ought to have been long ago.
It's like this brother let her be punished, but I must get better first.
I understand the queen of impudence.
You saw her all over in that hand-kissing, the she-devil.
She's magnificent in her own line.
I agree that hanging is too good for her.
